formula:
**FORMULA**

Risk is calculated using the cumulative incidence of Cox proportional hazard regression models from[Garibaldi 2020](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC7530643/).

how_to_use.why:
- Aide à identifier les patients présentant un risque plus élevé de maladie grave ou de décès, ce qui facilite les décisions d'admission en soins intensifs, de surveillance rapprochée et d'escalade des soins.
- Aide à la répartition des ressources (p. ex., utilisation des lits de soins intensifs), en particulier lors des pics d'affluence ou lorsque la capacité hospitalière est sous tension.
how_to_use.when: Utilisation chez les patients hospitalisés atteints de COVID-19 pour évaluer leur risque de détérioration clinique, en particulier au cours des premières 24–48 heures suivant l’admission, afin de guider la prise en charge et la surveillance.
how_to_use.pearls:
- Predicts outcomes at 2, 4, and 7 days of hospitalization, performing best in the first 2 days for assessing progression to severe disease or death.
- Performance may vary with new COVID-19 variants and evolving treatment protocols.
- Developed from 832 patients admitted to 5 hospitals in a single health care system in Maryland and Washington, D.C., from March to April of 2020.
- Patients younger than 18 years of age were excluded from analysis.
- 1 in 5 patients had DNR/DNI orders, potentially influencing treatment practices and mortality rates.

next_steps.advice:
- This tool should not be used in isolation—clinical judgment remains essential.
- Escalate care for high-risk patients (e.g., early ICU consult, closer monitoring) or consider de-escalation for low-risk patients when clinically appropriate.
- Results can be used to guide goals of care discussions with patients and families.
